title: The Auditorium/Stage
content: Does anyone else find themselves rehearsing and performing on the stage? In my dream last night, I was one of two acts to audition/perform for a part in some musical. The first act was well prepared, choreographed, and practiced. My act included a cast I had only just met, with no script or rehearsal, and the feeling of "let's wing it". The audition was a disaster, and I was embarrassed, but Pissed about the difference in prep between our act and the other. I was told someone behind the scenes sabotaged me because I didn't fill out my forms correctly? I've had numerous audition dreams, the one was most recent. TLDR: My audition on the big stage a disaster every time.
